post.text: Office hours reminder: talk to your users every week, not every quarter. Treat user research as a habit, not a milestone.

drafts.draftComment: Treating user research as a weekly habit instead of a quarterly milestone is a small reframe that compounds — going to block a recurring slot for it this week. 🙏

post.text: Default alive or default dead? It's a question you answer with a spreadsheet and your real burn — not a vibe. Know your number.

drafts.draftComment: The nudge to answer "default alive or dead" with the actual burn spreadsheet, not a gut feeling, landed for me. Turning a vague worry into a number you can act on is the useful move.

post.text: Conviction is easy on a good week. The founders who make it are the ones whose belief survives contact with a bad one.

drafts.draftComment: The split between conviction on a good week vs. a bad one is the part I'm keeping. It reframes resilience as something you pre-decide rather than something you have to summon in the moment.

post.text: The best way to understand something deeply is to build it from scratch once, even badly. Abstractions are great for shipping, terrible for learning.

drafts.draftComment: The "build it from scratch once, even badly" rule keeps proving itself for me — I only really understood tokenization after writing a clumsy one by hand. Good reminder that abstractions ship code but rarely teach it. 🧠
